about: Every case of the leak fixture; tests/unit/test_leak_fixture.py checks it and step 6 grades scripts/leak_lint.py from it. Every name, figure and id here is invented.

allowlist-attempts.note: adds seven allowlist rows to strand 001 that try to clear a figure, a quote, a copied run, a marker, a pain id, an exclusion and the other client's name

call-unmarked.note: the same call summary with its two client-safe marks removed, so the block's text is ordinary internal text

snapshot-unmarked.note: the same document snapshot with its two client-safe marks removed

third-party-excluded.note: adds the outside contact Gideon Pryce to strand 001's exclusions.md

steps: make an empty temporary folder and set MMB_HOME to it
copy settings and local_terms to their 'to' paths under the home
copy both records to their 'to' paths under the home
if the case names an overlay, copy the overlay's files over record a, path for path
run leak_lint.py index from each record in index_from order (--record <home>/clients/<slug>)

install the case's files: copy each 'from' to its record-relative 'to', creating folders; for a 'zip' entry, zip every file under that fixture folder with zipfile, member names relative to it in POSIX spelling, and write the archive to 'to'
run leak_lint.py --record <home>/clients/<slug of the case's record> <command> <args...>

a planted case passes when the exit code equals 'exit', the printed verdict equals 'verdict' and every 'expect' entry is matched by a finding of the same rule and severity at the same 'where' (and the same class when 'class' is not null); other findings are reported, not failed
a twin passes when the exit code equals 'exit', there is no finding of severity block, and every 'expect' entry (a warning the twin is known to carry) is matched
a case with 'unchanged' also proves its installed file is byte-equal after the run
